unsafe_justifications: Production has one unsafe operation: ParsedMessage::new_proven. It moves the validator's payload, decoded arena, and proof intact after checking original payload equality, proof lengths, profile fingerprint, exact slot count and kinds, checked span bounds, string UTF-8 and scalar counts, literal event tag, symbol byte limit, and update ID ordering. An independent strict cursor traversal checks the complete original wrapper and document, compares every slot with its wire value or exact array span, validates every level, and creates fully owned decimal vectors. No cursor or temporary decimal buffer references escape.

The cfg(test) TestValidator issues ValidationProof only after strict capture and the complete production document and semantic validation have succeeded for the exact returned immutable owners. Length conversions are checked. Adversarial slot tests mutate these genuine returned slots to exercise rejection; production code never issues a proof.
